concepts.quote: Still -2147483648, because +2147483648 does not fit in an int.
concepts.why: Correctly relates the result to int's fixed 32-bit range: the true absolute value is outside the range so the int result stays at MIN_VALUE, confirmed by the run.
The answer says nothing about primitive types as such beyond the int range already graded under int.
The answer makes no claim about int literals or compile-time literal limits.
